extension.description: Correctness-first language support for the Elisa programming language.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: Lexical highlighting works in Restricted Mode. Workspace-selected server executables and workspace protocol tracing are disabled; a user-configured server or one found through ELISA_LSP/PATH may provide semantic features.

configuration.title: Elisa
configuration.languageServer.path.descri: Path to the elisa-lsp executable. Supports an absolute path, a path relative to the first workspace folder, or a leading ~ for the home directory. Workspace/folder overrides are ignored in untrusted workspaces. When empty, the extension checks ELISA_LSP, a nearby Elisa-LSP build (trusted workspaces only), and PATH.
configuration.trace.server.description: Protocol trace level for the Elisa language server. 'verbose' can include source code; enable only for temporary diagnostics and disable when finished. Workspace/folder overrides are ignored in untrusted workspaces.
